question: Which of the following is the correct chronological order of the rulers of the Tughluq dynasty who ruled over Delhi from the year 1320 to 1414?

options.text: Ghiyasuddin Tughluq, Firuz Shah Tughluq, Muhammad Tughluq
Firuz Shah Tughluq, Muhammad Tughluq, Ghiyasuddin Tughluq
Ghiyasuddin Tughluq, Muhammad Tughluq, Firuz Shah Tughluq
Muhammad Tughluq, Firuz Shah Tughluq, Ghiyasuddin Tughluq

solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq:

 
 
• ​He was also known as Ghazi Malik. 
 
• He built the city of Tughlaqabad near Delhi.
 
• Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq was the founder of the Tughlaq dynasty.
 
 
 
• Muhammad Tughluq:
 
 
• The Sultanate was attacked in the early years of Muhammad Tughluq’s reign.
 
• The Mongol army was defeated. Muhammad Tughluq was confident about the strength of his army and his resources to plan an attack on Transoxiana.
 
• He, therefore, raised a large standing army.
 
 
 
• Firoz Shah Tughlaq:
 
 
• ​He was the first Sultan to impose an irrigation tax*.*
 
• But at the same time, he dug irrigation canals and Wells.
 
• The longest Canal was about 200 km from Sutlej to Hansi.
